# Collegium Template Tasks & Design Notes

- **Source**: ColorLib UniversityEdu (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/universityedu/`)
- **Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/universityedu/`
- **Assigned Name**: `collegium` (`apps/collegium`)
- **Design Tokens**:
  - Primary: `#007A5C` (Emerald)
  - Accent background: `#FCF2EB` (Cream)
  - Footer bg: `#32404D`
  - Font: Chivo
- **Sections**:
  1. Top bar (announcement + countdown + button) + Main Navbar (logo, menu, phone, social)
  2. Hero area (`slider-area`, heading, CTA)
  3. About area (`section-bg`, "A comprehensive teaching approach")
  4. Programs Offer area (Faculty of Science & Arts)
  5. Essential Resources area (Student year groups & tuition)
  6. Top Stories blog section
  7. Trusted students section
  8. Footer with Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`)
